purpose: Remove the release-profile indirection layer from the [release] config schema and from ReleaseIntentV1: forge-repository moves directly under [release]; [release.profiles] and registry-routes are removed from RawConfig/ResolvedConfig; the CLI --profile flag is removed from release plan and release execute; registry-key routing goes directly through the registry's own configured key with no per-profile remap; ReleaseIntentV1's profile field is removed with a schema-version bump, and ReleaseRunEnvelopeV1's corresponding profile field and schema version follow it. A load-time migration reads a legacy [release.profiles.production].forge-repository so an unmigrated callisto.toml keeps loading. Includes the config::resolve(RawConfig) split out of config::load that SPEC-DX-SETUP-CORE's in-memory preview depends on.
scope: The [release] table schema (RawProductReleaseConfig/ProductReleaseConfig/ReleaseProfileConfig in crates/callisto-graph/src/config/raw.rs and resolve.rs) and its load-time migration from [release.profiles.production]; config::resolve(RawConfig) split from config::load(root); ReleasePlanArgs/ReleaseExecuteArgs --profile flag removal in crates/callisto-cli/src/cli.rs and the plan/execute command bodies in crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/release.rs; the CLI/graph errors that named a release profile (ReleaseProfileInvalid, ReleaseProfileMismatch, ReleaseProfileRepositoryMismatch, the profile-keyed artifact-destination mismatch) and their replacements; prepared_registry_binding's registry-key routing in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/binding.rs with the registry_routes indirection removed; ReleaseIntentV1's profile field removal and SCHEMA_VERSION bump, and ReleaseRunEnvelopeV1's corresponding field removal and schema bump, in crates/callisto-model/src/release.rs; migrating .github/workflows/callisto-release.yml and .github/tests/verify-release-workflow-contract.sh off --profile; migrating this repository's own root callisto.toml to the new schema. SPEC-DX-SETUP-CORE depends on this spec for the [release] table shape its AC-005/AC-009/AC-023 write against and for config::resolve(RawConfig)'s existence.
non_goals: Registry credential handling, endpoint URL validation, or the built-in registry list (builtin_registry_url) -- unaffected by removing the profile indirection.
Artifact slot structure, attestation policy, or ArtifactManifestV1 -- unaffected by the intent schema bump.
The init command's own question flow, config-write behavior, or preview -- SPEC-DX-SETUP-CORE's territory; this spec defines the schema init writes against, not init's own behavior.

Rehearsal/staging destinations beyond the single production forge-repository -- removing profiles collapses the workspace to one configured destination; no replacement multi-destination mechanism is introduced.
ExecutionTrustProfileV1 (a distinct, unrelated 'profile' concept covering commit-vs-hermetic trust) -- untouched by this spec; only ReleaseProfileId-based release-destination profiles are removed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A callisto.toml with [release] containing a top-level forge-repository key and no [release.profiles] table resolves via config::resolve such that the resolved product-release's forge_repository equals that value.

A callisto.toml with [release.profiles.production].forge-repository set and no top-level [release].forge-repository key resolves successfully, with the resolved forge_repository equal to that profile's value.

A callisto.toml declaring both a top-level [release].forge-repository and a [release.profiles.production].forge-repository with different values fails config::resolve with an error naming both configured values.

A callisto.toml declaring both a top-level [release].forge-repository and a [release.profiles.production].forge-repository with the same value resolves successfully using that value; the duplication is not an error.

A callisto.toml declaring any [release.profiles.<name>] table where <name> is not "production" fails config::resolve with an error naming <name> and stating that only a top-level [release].forge-repository key, or the production profile name for migration, is accepted.
A registry-routes key present under [release.profiles.production] is never read into ResolvedConfig and never affects registry-key resolution; its presence or absence changes nothing observable.

Resolving a publish target's registry destination looks up the target's logical registry key directly against the workspace's [registries.<key>] table, or a built-in registry default when unconfigured; no release-profile value participates in the lookup and no per-target override remaps one registry key to another.

The 'unknown registry' and 'incompatible ecosystem' errors produced during registry-key resolution no longer mention a release profile in their text; they name only the registry key and, for the ecosystem case, the mismatched ecosystem.
callisto release plan no longer accepts a --profile flag; supplying --profile fails as an unrecognized argument before any workspace is loaded.
callisto release execute no longer accepts a --profile flag; supplying --profile fails as an unrecognized argument before any workspace is loaded.

callisto release plan and callisto release execute run against the single configured [release].forge-repository destination (or against no product-release destination when [release] is absent) with no profile-selection input required or accepted.

At execute time, an intent whose artifact-slot repository differs from the workspace's configured [release].forge-repository errors, naming the configured and requested repository values, with no profile identifier anywhere in the message.

CliError no longer defines ReleaseProfileInvalid, ReleaseProfileMismatch, or ReleaseProfileRepositoryMismatch; none of the three is producible because their sole trigger, the --profile flag, no longer exists.
ReleaseIntentV1's profile field, and its contribution to the canonical digest transcript, are removed; ReleaseIntentV1::SCHEMA_VERSION increments by one from its value at implementation time.
A release-intent JSON document whose schemaVersion is not 5 fails to deserialize with an error naming the found version.

ReleaseRunEnvelopeV1's profile field, and its cross-check against the intent's former profile field, are removed; ReleaseRunEnvelopeV1::SCHEMA_VERSION increments by one from its value at implementation time (PR #124 already moves it to 2), and a run-envelope JSON document whose schemaVersion is not 2 fails to deserialize with an error naming the found version.

config::resolve(RawConfig) accepts an already-parsed, in-memory RawConfig value and performs the same validation and defaulting that config::load(root) performs after reading and parsing callisto.toml from disk; config::load(root) becomes a thin wrapper that reads the file, parses it into RawConfig, and delegates to config::resolve, producing an identical ResolvedConfig to a direct config::resolve call on the same parsed content.

.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml's release plan and release execute invocations no longer pass --profile production; .github/tests/verify-release-workflow-contract.sh's asserted execute args array is updated to match, with no --profile token in either file.

This repository's own root callisto.toml is migrated: [release.profiles.production] is replaced with a top-level forge-repository = "orin-dx/callisto" key directly under [release], and its registry-routes key is removed.

reasoning: Split out of SPEC-DX-SETUP-CORE per GATE2-FIXES.md's SPEC-DX-SETUP-CORE section, first bullet. Verified against origin/main: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/raw.rs (RawProductReleaseConfig.profiles: Option<BTreeMap<String, RawReleaseProfileConfig>>, RawReleaseProfileConfig{forge_repository, registry_routes} -- the exact shape this spec removes) and resolve.rs (resolve_product_release/resolve_release_profile, ProductReleaseConfig.profiles: BTreeMap<ReleaseProfileId, ReleaseProfileConfig>); crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/binding.rs (prepared_registry_binding(workspace, target, profile: Option<&ReleaseProfileConfig>) -- current profile-indirected routing this spec collapses to direct registry-key lookup); crates/callisto-cli/src/cli.rs (ReleasePlanArgs.profile / ReleaseExecuteArgs.profile, both `#[arg(long, default_value = ReleaseProfileId::PRODUCTION)]`) and commands/release.rs (plan/execute bodies reading args.profile, the profile-repository-mismatch checks at lines ~206-220 and ~358-371); crates/callisto-cli/src/error.rs (ReleaseProfileInvalid/ReleaseProfileMismatch/ReleaseProfileRepositoryMismatch/ReleaseArtifactDestinationMismatch variants removed or reworded); crates/callisto-model/src/release.rs (ReleaseIntentV1{schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION = 4, profile: ReleaseProfileId, ...} and its digest_intent transcript pushing "profile"; ReleaseRunEnvelopeV1{schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION = 1, profile: ReleaseProfileId, ...} and its validate_for_intent profile cross-check; ReleaseProfileId::parse/production()); .github/workflows/callisto-release.yml (lines 232, 470: `--profile production`) and .github/tests/verify-release-workflow-contract.sh (line 68: asserted execute args array containing `--profile production`) -- both confirmed live consumers, so migrated in the same change per the repo's sibling-consumer-migration rule rather than deferred. Root callisto.toml confirmed to declare exactly [release.profiles.production] with forge-repository and registry-routes = { cratesIo = "cratesIo" }, no other profile name, matching AC-019's migration target. api_surface omitted: the target signatures for prepared_registry_binding (profile parameter dropped) and config::resolve(RawConfig) do not exist yet in this exact shape, so criteria describe behavior observably rather than citing a signature that would overreach this spec's scope.
